messages.author: 6901a60a784045af
messages.subject: Question regarding tiling
parts:
Hello,
Thanks for the great tool. I have a quick question regarding the validity check for tileMethylCounts function. For this particular experiment I have 9 samples (5 called MORs and 3 called FORS). Now, when I am performing DMR analysis, while I am doing tiling, I am getting the following warning "object has more than one sample id: only one allowed". While reading the data I am reading it based on the default resolution, i.e. base, and filtering it based on criteria defined in the tutorial. I could not attach the code and the output, let me know where I can send those, for your perusal. I have 2 questions in this case:
a) Should I ignore this warning?
b) If not is there a special way to handle DMRs?

Please let me know if you have any further questions.

Thanks,
Surajit
